page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this server allocates 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core.

The primary hardware feature of this instance is its single GPU equipped with 96 GB of dedicated VRAM, designed to handle memory-intensive parallel computing tasks. However, the instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Given the high VRAM-to-system-memory ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.gn8v-tee.6xlarge is structured for workloads such as deep learning inference, large-scale graphics rendering, and data parallel processing. Qualitatively, the lack of local storage represents a resource-density tradeoff, positioning this instance as a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy GPU tasks that rely on centralized network storage rather than high-speed local disk I/O.
